name: Inclusion
overview: Scripture calls believers to a Christ-centered practice of inclusion characterized by love, kindness, and mutual acceptance. Jesus instructs us to reach out to those often overlooked, such as the poor and disabled, demonstrating a heart of hospitality (Luke 14:13). The apostle Paul emphasizes rejoicing and weeping together, reflecting deep empathy and unity (Romans 12:15), and urges believers to receive one another just as Christ received us, bringing glory to God (Romans 15:7). Ultimately, in Christ there is no division by ethnicity, social status, or gender, for all are one body called to love one another as Christ loved us (Galatians 3:28; John 13:34; Ephesians 4:32).
